strengths: Thirty-four tabs model a realistic layered transaction workbook: sources, imports, assumptions, valuation, tax, entries, checks, and backups.
The workbook contains 183,452 populated cells and 2,413 formulas.
defects: The canonical rejection record says the draft exposed neutral totals, lacked reconstruction evidence, contained unplanned defects, mirrored the seller workbook too closely, and used mechanical filler.
Exact builder, configuration, issue-ledger, and release lineage were not bound.
confidence_limits: Retained only for forensic comparison; no stored mechanical PASS promotes it.

patterns: Layer raw imports, sources, assumptions, analysis schedules, tax, entries, checks, and visibly superseded side work in a complex workbook.
prohibited_content: All workbook bytes, values, formulas, identities, conclusions, defect mechanisms, mirrored tab structures, and visual styling.
sanitization: Do not sanitize this workbook into a template; design a new workbook using only the abstract layered architecture.
proof_gate: A new implementation must bind its builder and configuration, reconstruct every conclusion from visible evidence, and pass anti-filler and cross-party differentiation review.
